promise: "I am pleased to announce that South Africa is increasing its pledge to 13.5 million U.S. dollars as our commitment to solidarity and sovereignty for the people of this continent."
description: President Cyril Ramaphosa increased South Africa's financial contribution to the Ebola response for the outbreaks in DR Congo and Uganda to US$13.5 million, part of a broader African Union plan running from June to November 2026 to strengthen outbreak control and preparedness in at least ten high-risk states.
evidence: Pledge increased to $13.5 million announced June 16, 2026
Funding forms part of the African Union Ebola plan running June-November 2026

promise: "Submit to the rule of law or face the firm response of the Colombian state and its security forces" - launch an uncompromising crackdown on armed groups and drug cartels
description: In his inaugural address on August 7, 2026, President Abelardo de la Espriella vowed a fierce crackdown on drug trafficking and armed groups, declaring that the option of peace talks was 'completely exhausted' and that it was 'time to permanently eradicate the scourge of illicit crops'. Analysts expect the new administration to focus its first 100 days on security and anti-corruption measures.
evidence: Inaugural address pledges crackdown on armed groups and drug cartels
First-100-days focus on security expected, running to mid-November 2026
